answer: Make every new agent post a bond that unlocks slowly, like a seed waiting out a tundra winter. A swarm of fake identities then ties up real capital, and any clone caught double-voting forfeits its stake. Pair that with reputation earned only through peer-verified work, so trust is carved patiently like ivory rather than minted for free, and a sybil army stays as costly and brittle as cracked quartz.
